recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for this issue unless the work group later chooses to revisit RESTful delete policy more broadly.
issue_request: FHIR-5691 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core HTTP change request asking the specification to clarify what a non-version-capable server must do for delete requests and whether it may actually delete the resource.
initial_application: The issue was applied by git-svn commit e87ca6573175c7049611dd195ebebef8edb2c4b7, corresponding to svn 4487, which added server-discretion delete wording and limited the version-history preservation note to servers that maintain version history.
additional_context: Current source/http.html is a top-level HTTP source page and still states that versioning support is optional, defines no-version CapabilityStatement behavior, leaves delete support to server policy/business rules, scopes history-retention behavior to servers that maintain history, and allows complete deletion of the resource and history when policy or business rules make that appropriate. Later git history reinforced this delete-policy caveat, and no directly relevant conflicting Zulip or Confluence record was found.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source already preserves the FHIR-5691 clarification, and adding more prose would be redundant rather than corrective.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core HTTP issue requesting clearer delete responsibilities for servers without versioning support.
evidence_items.learned: The work group wanted notes adjusted so non-versioning delete behavior, including server discretion, was explicit.

evidence_items.summary: The current HTTP page states versioning is optional, defines no-version behavior, and makes delete support and complete deletion subject to server policy/business rules.
evidence_items.learned: The current source already preserves the FHIR-5691 clarification without needing new wording.

evidence_items.summary: Commit '#5691: add notes about version history and deletion' from 2015-03-14 applied svn 4487 to source/http.html.
evidence_items.learned: The Jira implementation directly touched the current authoritative HTTP source page.

evidence_items.summary: Commit 'GF#16447 - policy note on delete' later added that servers may completely delete a resource and its history when policy or business rules make that appropriate.
evidence_items.learned: Later source history supports the same server-discretion interpretation rather than revealing a missed FHIR-5691 fix.
